title: Being quasi-finite, respectively locally quasi-finite, is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts fpqc locality on the base for 'locally quasi-finite' and for 'quasi-finite' (statement lines 6333-6340). The proof assumes an fpqc covering whose base changes are locally quasi-finite: since 'locally of finite type' is already known to descend, f is locally of finite type, and then the base-change characterisation of local quasi-finiteness gives the conclusion; the quasi-finite case follows because 'quasi-compact' is likewise already known to descend (proof lines 6342-6354). The level is H2: both properties are reduced to a finite list of already established descent statements plus one characterisation lemma, and the two halves of the argument are displayed separately.
